experimentalUnderlay.description: Skipped: current first idle does not match known exact or palette-invariant reference structure
experimentalUnderlay.scope: 12 item templates; 24 firearm IDs/25 source masks; source-layer recognition is experimental with added equipment
experimentalUnderlay.note: v88 invokes source-layer matching only when the previously accepted exact and swatch-aware paths reject a valid firearm state. It reads original swatch-adjusted item arrays and writes within those same arrays at the item layer depth, never the firearm. Codes 8001-8012 represent Bolt source matches; 8099 represents multiple items. Other source-recognized firearms may use a higher code. Unsupported source arrangements still skip. The independent v80 hand-color source108 failure is NOT repaired.
